name: Jeremiah
bio: Jeremiah was a prophet of Judah. His first mention in Scripture comes at the death of King Josiah in 638 BC: when Josiah died at Megiddo, Jeremiah composed a lament for him that the singing men and women of Israel continued to sing in his memory, a tradition still kept at the time Chronicles was written (2 Chronicles 35:25). His own long and eventful ministry is told in detail in the book that bears his name. Chronicles closes the book of Kings' story by tying the exile directly to Jeremiah's prophetic word: the land's seventy years of desolation and sabbath rest fulfilled what the LORD had spoken through him, and it was likewise to fulfill his word that the LORD later stirred up Cyrus of Persia to let the exiles return (2 Chronicles 36:21-22).
